items.headline: New Launch: $UMIA Raises $6.1M in 7-Day Auction
items.summary: Umia raised $6.11M at an $18M FDV via a seven-day $UMIA token auction, drawing ten funds and nearly 700 individual bidders. The platform helps crypto projects launch tokens.

items.headline: Cronje's Flying Tulip $FT Options Market Tops $5M
items.summary: Flying Tulip's NFT options market passed $5M in volume, per Andre Cronje. Buying an ftPUT NFT transfers remaining $FT tokens and redemption rights, unlike unprotected spot buys.

items.headline: Base Vault Drained of $6M in $AAVE Deposit Tokens
items.summary: A Base vault lost about $6M in $AAVE deposit tokens after a borrower-whitelist change. Proceeds were redeemed for wstETH and partly bridged toward Ethereum.

items.headline: Injective CEO: US $INJ ETFs Could Launch Before 2027
items.summary: Injective CEO Eric Chen expects US-listed $INJ ETFs sooner than 2027. Two applications are pending: the 21Shares Injective ETF and the Canary Staked INJ ETF.

items.headline: $PLUME Opens Tokenized Vault Backed by Fidelity ETF
items.summary: Plume's nBND vault holds shares of Fidelity's actively managed Total Bond ETF, pushing onchain fixed income beyond T-bills into credit and duration on $PLUME.
